B1+ English Listening Test

Watch a video about how forensic scientists fight crime by analysing handwriting. For questions 1 to 6 choose the correct option.

See the full list of B1+ listening tests

questions.prompt: Only three people in the state specialise in handwriting forensics.
Which of these things the forensic scientist doesn’t say they analyse?
To train for this job, students are given real crime documents to analyse.
If a criminal writes with their opposite hand, or with their foot, mouth, etc. ...

choices.html: you can also identify and analyse their writing
you need a computer to analyse their writing

questions.prompt: The technique the expert shows us can be used to ...

choices.html: identify text that has been added to an original document
identify text that has been erased from an original document
identify the person who has written the text
